name: Strip: remove the original clothing first
description: Before anything else, remove ALL clothing from the subject in the incoming image: the swimsuit top and bottom, every strap and string at the neck, back, sides and hips, all jewelry and all shoes, leaving bare skin everywhere they were, so that nothing of the original clothing remains. Then apply only what is described below.
notes: Optional line (components.strip). Tells the model to remove the A-pose swimsuit before the new outfit or armor is applied.
